contracts: Each independent assertion is driven by real compiled C# production observations, transported by exact-case dotnet test and fresh TRX to the focused Python assertion. Successful configuration loading, service calls and actual projection payload/capability observations prove behavior; source-text scans or a missing future helper do not. Build errors, missing compile-time members, skipped cases, invalid/missing/stale TRX or fabricated guard results are harness failures, never expected-red. Runtime data-field absence can be a valid observation and must be handled safely. Keep truthful already-passing cases; do not prebuild production or force failures. Completion proves the bounded same-host logical authority contract only, not Windows Runner ACL isolation or a remote credential protocol.
